mapper.select:
select * from (SELECT ja.archive_id, ja.project_id, ja.archive_number, ja.archive_name, ja.uuid, pp.project_number, pp.project_name, ( SELECT wm_concat( hbm.bp_name ) FROM hls_bp_master hbm, prj_project_bp ppb WHERE ppb.project_id = pp.project_id AND ppb.bp_id = hbm.bp_id AND ppb.bp_type = 'TENANT' ) AS bp_name, ( SELECT s.description FROM sys_user s WHERE s.user_id = pp.host_project_manager ) AS project_manager, ja.archive_type, ( SELECT sc.meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v sc WHERE sc.CODE = 'JC_FILE_TYPE' AND ja.archive_type = sc.code_value ) AS archive_type_n, CASE WHEN ja.archive_type IN ( 'MANAGEMENT_CLASS', 'GENERAL_CLASS' ) THEN '30年' ELSE '永久' END AS storage_period, ( SELECT s.description FROM sys_user s WHERE s.user_id = ja.archivist_id ) AS archivist_id_n, ja.handover_status, ( SELECT meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v WHERE CODE = 'HLS_WFL_STATUS' AND code_value = ja.handover_status ) as handover_status_n, ja.handover_date, ja.archived_flag, ( SELECT meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v WHERE CODE = 'SYS.YES_NO' AND code_value = ja.archived_flag ) archived_flag_n, ja.archived_date, ja.description, ja.creation_date FROM jc_archive ja, prj_project pp WHERE ja.project_id = pp.project_id) TAB
1=1
AND TAB.archive_id in (select a.archive_id from jc_archive_approval a where a.process_instance_id = #{processInstanceId})
AND TAB.archive_number like concat('%',concat(#{archiveNumber},'%'))
AND TAB.archive_name like concat('%',concat(#{archiveName},'%'))
AND TAB.project_number like concat('%',concat(#{projectNumber},'%'))
AND TAB.project_name like concat('%',concat(#{projectName},'%'))
AND TAB.bp_name like concat('%',concat(#{bpName},'%'))
AND TAB.archive_type = #{archiveType}
AND TAB.project_manager like concat('%',concat(#{projectManager},'%'))
AND TAB.archivist_id_n like concat('%',concat(#{archivistIdN},'%'))
AND TAB.archived_flag = #{archivedFlag}
and to_char(TAB.archived_date,'YYYY-MM-DD') >= #{archivedDateFrom}
and to_char(TAB.archived_date,'YYYY-MM-DD') <= #{archivedDateTo}
order by TAB.creation_date desc
SELECT * FROM jc_archive ja WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM jc_archive_attachment aa WHERE aa.archive_type = ja.archive_type AND aa.uuid = ja.uuid )
